title: Mesh
description: See the mesh around you and manage the hubs you connect to.
summary: A live map of the mesh as this device sees it. It shows Reticulum nodes and hubs and the links between them. It also shows the XPRS stations heard over Bluetooth and LAN and LoRa. Tap a station to see its signal and uptime. You also see the mail it carries. Filter by service and highlight the peers that run XPRS. Manage the hubs you use on the internet and turn relay mode on or off. The map only shows what this device heard. It is never a full list of a hub's clients.
